title: Cosmic Atlas: a 3D map of the real universe in the browser
description:
A browser 3D map of the universe built only from open survey data: the Solar System at its real positions, Gaia DR3 stars, 3D dust, star clusters, the Local Group, 15 million DESI DR1 galaxies and quasars, gravitational-wave localisation volumes, FRBs, neutrinos and the Planck CMB. Large layers stream as octree tiles with distance uncertainty, and every number on screen has a cited source. WebGPU with a WebGL2 fallback; interface and articles in Uzbek, English and Russian.

Live: ismoilovdevml.github.io/cosmic-atlas. Data keep their own licences; Gaia is CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO, so the project is non-commercial.
